notes: Safety gates are active in the Phase 0 evaluator on every run.
Phase 1 exit targets are the Workset Search 2.0 release targets and must not be relaxed in the same change that fails them.
Delivered time to first evidence currently has buffered-response semantics and therefore equals completion when evidence is returned.
The token target uses ceil(structured UTF-8 bytes plus text UTF-8 bytes divided by 3); no representative tokenizer gate is claimed until a tokenizer dependency is pinned.
Size 50 is a latency gate only and does not replace any required correctness size.
